title: Not bad, not great, merely MEH
text:
Not bad, not great, merely MEH. I wanted to give this teapot five stars. But there’s some real issues with it. Some may think these are minor issues, but to me they were great.

First, the good things. It is pretty; it maintains the heat of the tea, if you preheat it; the handle is large enough so even someone with large hands can pick it up.

The problems are all associated with the lid. If you keep the infuser in the pot the whole time you’re drinking the tea, the lid is tight. However, if you keep the infuser in the pot for the entire time that you’re drinking the tea, the tea becomes bitter. And in my case very better. So, I do not use the infuser. Then, using the pot becomes difficult.

This is an easily fixed resolvable issue. I hope the company resolves it.

product_metadata.title: Sweese 221.101 Teapot, Porcelain Tea Pot with Stainless Steel Infuser, Blooming & Loose Leaf Teapot - 27 ounce, White
features: EVERYDAY TEAPOT - A perfectly serviceable teapot. Sturdy, pleasing shade, nice weight, size of 27oz. It is beautiful happy, high gloss, and very classy. Just makes you happy to walk into the kitchen and start your tea time!

TEA MADE IN THIS POT TASTES AND SMELLS FRESH & FLAVORFUL - The handle is the correct shape to allow for easy pouring and the spout doesn't drip. PRO-GRADE PORCELAIN & SAFE FOR DISHWASHER, MICROWAVE - These Sweese porcelains are made of durable porcelain, a type of premium LEAD-FREE ceramic, chip-resistant and more sturdy than stoneware. The only thing that you should keep in mind is that this is NOT a kettle. It is a POT. Do not put it on a heating element.
SMART DESIGN - Pouring tea by holding the Infuser tab to the handle with your thumb as you pour, which is natural and easy.
